get.description: Lists the account's subscriptions with combinable filters and page-based pagination. All statuses are returned unless the `status` filter is set. Results are sorted by `created_at` descending. Each item is a summary — a subset of [the subscription object](/reference/subscriptions/the-subscription-object); fetch the full detail with [Retrieve Subscription](/reference/subscriptions/retrieve-subscription).

parameters.name: X-account-code
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the account whose subscriptions are listed. Required.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. Values below 1 are rejected with `400 BAD_REQUEST`.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Items per page. 1-100, defaults to 20. Values outside the range are rejected with `400 BAD_REQUEST`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by subscription status. Accepts a comma-separated multi-value, e.g. `ACTIVE,PAUSED`. Valid values: `CREATED`, `ACTIVE`, `TRIALING`, `PAUSED`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELED`, `ERROR`.

parameters.name: plan_id
parameters.description: Filter by plan identifier (UUID). An unknown plan returns an empty list.

parameters.name: created_at_from
parameters.description: Filter by creation date from (ISO-8601 with offset, inclusive), e.g. `2026-07-01T00:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: created_at_to
parameters.description: Filter by creation date to (ISO-8601 with offset, inclusive).

parameters.name: payment_method_type
parameters.description: Filter by payment method type, e.g. `CARD`. Exact match.

messages: The size must be at most 100.
